targets.rationale: The August 9 race-director pitch is an explicit future appointment, distinct from the August 10 marathon pop-up. The keyed event kind and day are supported. Inspection of all 48 events and 33 todos shows no pitch appointment under any title; before and after stores are identical. The state-level failure is justified, but cannot be attributed to model reasoning: the secretary MCP server failed, no email body was observed, and there were no tool calls. AMBIGUOUS denotes inability to assess model handling of the request under this infrastructure failure, not uncertainty about the required calendar date. Default timing would be 09:00–10:00, though this target grades only the day.
